items.title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Has Rare Cautionary Note on AI Safety
items.title_ko: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Has Rare Cautionary Note on AI Safety
items.summary_ko: Speaking at a tech forum in Kyoto, Masayoshi Son called for global cooperation on AI safeguards, warning that superintelligence could pose a greater threat than conflict between humans if misused. Bloomberg tech editor Mayumi Negishi said the caution marks a notable shift in tone from the longtime technology optimist, though Son remains strongly bullish on AI.
